villagemaster/30520.htm.text: Warehouse Chief Reed: Greetings, traveler! I am Warehouse Chief Reed of the famous Iron Gate Guild . As you undoubtedly know, we are the most influential guild in the kingdom. Just look at all the banks and warehouses we operate even in the Human villages!

links.text: Ask about the first class transfer.
Ask about the Iron Gate Guild.

villagemaster/30520-1.htm.text: Warehouse Chief Reed: Ours is the largest and most powerful of the 6 Dwarven guilds, dating back nearly 1,000 years and made up of only the most skilled traders and bankers. We have warehouses in every city on the continent! In fact, our commerce knows no borders -- our customers stretch from the b…

Q00005_MinersFavor/30520-02.html.text: Warehouse Chief Reed: Look here, I'm trying to organize my account book! Bolter's beer? I already gave you the Redstone Beer! If you drank it already, it's not my fault!

Q00005_MinersFavor/30520-01.html.text: Warehouse Chief Reed: The item Bolter entrusted to me...? Ah! You mean the Dion-brewed Redstone Beer he gave me last week! Where is it...here! It goes down very smooth, I can tell you that. Just the thing to wash away the dust of the road. Just thinking about it makes me thirsty... Well, well...uh,…

Q00010_IntoTheWorld/30520-01.html.text: Warehouse Chief Reed: Not every Dwarf is granted membership in our Iron Gate Guild. Why are you here?

links.text: "To tell you about Silver Scale Balanki's work."

Q00010_IntoTheWorld/30520-03.html.text: Warehouse Chief Reed: Speak with Priest of the Earth Gerald at the town entrance. Don't tell him I sent you! Understand? Give him this necklace and perhaps he'll tell you the secret.

Q00010_IntoTheWorld/30520-04.html.text: Warehouse Chief Reed: Back already? Did Gerald like the necklace I sent?What did he say about the strip mining rights?

links.text: Tell him about the hint Gerald gave you.

Q00010_IntoTheWorld/30520-06.html.text: Warehouse Chief Reed: About time you left, isn't it?! What's keeping you? Go to Balanki and tell him that I'm fine.

Q00010_IntoTheWorld/30520-02.html.text: Warehouse Chief Reed: I can't believe Balanki fell for it, you silver-tongued devil! It's a wonder that you even survived, much less kept your Adena. He must be losing his touch! Ha! You know, I think I like you! I'm going to help you, but you must pretend to do something in return in order to keep…

Q00010_IntoTheWorld/30520-05.html.text: Warehouse Chief Reed: Bah! Why does he always have to be so mysterious! Well, that hint should be sufficient.
